annotations.title: Find a workflow for a task

description: Before multi-step work, find a proven step-by-step plan for the task: checking whether a ruling or a provision still holds, a memo with sources, a matter digest, procedure and deadlines, what an article said on a date. The user's own workflows first, then Avokata's. Returns the best matches with why they fit, or that none fits and how to write one. Cheap: no search is run.

limit.description: How many workflows to return, 1-5, default 3. The account's own come first, then the shipped ones, each with why it fits.
limit.title: Limit

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

task.description: The work you are about to do, in a sentence - in the user's words; Lithuanian matches best (`ar dar galiu remtis šia nutartimi`, `atmintinė su šaltiniais`).
task.title: Task

name: find_workflow
